Vulkan API declarations from KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Headers tag **v1.1.126**:
https://github.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Headers/tree/v1.1.126

Only `vulkan_core.h`, `vk_platform.h` and their Apache-2.0 license are vendored.
Copyright/license notices are retained unchanged. These are source declarations,
not a Vulkan SDK, loader, driver, runtime or shader compiler. The Windows runtime
loads the user's installed `vulkan-1.dll`; SPIR-V is compiled locally from the
project's original HLSL using an installed SPIR-V-capable DXC.
